programs.title: The Grand Canal Ep.6
programs.desc: With the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal as longitude and its 3,000-year history as latitude, this series traces the canal's development from multiple angles, tells the life stories of those along its banks, and reveals the unique status of this world cultural heritage.

programs.title: Enduring Legacy: Historical and Cultural Cities Ep.13
programs.desc: Framed by China’s 5,000-year historical tapestry, this series examines distinctive ancient cities as living chronicles of civilization. Blending digital recreations with real-world visuals, it traces urban development patterns while capturing contemporary vitality.
